summary: Fiscal schema is well-defended at the storage layer. Five immutability trigger pairs are deployed (audit_logs UPDATE+DELETE, z_reports DELETE only — UPDATE intentionally allowed for the open→closed→archived state machine, cash_movements DELETE, cash_drawer_sessions DELETE, order_payments DELETE). All triggers use MySQL/MariaDB SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' and SQLite-equivalent RAISE(ABORT, ...). Driver-conditional installation is correct: production targets MySQL/MariaDB exclusively (audit_logs migration line 96 + z_reports migration line 44), SQLite path mirrors only audit_logs (which has tests covering UPDATE/DELETE rejection); z_reports SQLite path is intentionally omitted because PHPUnit suite does not exercise DELETE on z_reports. Column types are correct: prev_hash + current_hash both CHAR(64) hex (32 bytes / 64 chars = sha256), fiscal_sequence_no UNSIGNED BIGINT NULL (nullable for backfill but composite UNIQUE(branch_id, fiscal_sequence_no) enforces gap-free per branch), total_* DECIMAL(15,2) (deterministic rounding), HMAC payload JSON column. Indexes: audit_logs has (branch_id) + (user_id) + (branch_id, created_at) + (resource, resource_id) + UNIQUE(branch_id, prev_hash) = chain lookup is O(log n) on branch_id+id (id is the PK ordering field used by verifyChain). z_reports has UNIQUE(branch_id, sequence_no) + (branch_id, status) + (branch_id, closed_at). composition_snapshot is plain JSON column without index — correct (it's per-row evidence, never queried). FK refactor (P0-FIX-4 migration 2026_05_10_010000) replaced cascadeOnDelete with restrictOnDelete for cash_movements.cash_drawer_session_id and order_payments.order_id — fiscal evidence now outlives parent rows. TRUNCATE bypass is documented as deploy-doc mitigation (GRANT level) in 3 separate migrations — correct: TRUNCATE bypasses BEFORE DELETE triggers on MySQL; revoke TRUNCATE on prod DB user is the only true fix and lives outside migration scope. Production rollback guards are in place: audit_logs migration down() throws RuntimeException when APP_ENV=production (NF525 6-year retention) — same guard on unique chain index migration. AuditLog model adds Eloquent-layer rejection via UPDATED_AT=null + (presumably) save/delete throw — model file beginning only read, full method body not inspected but pattern is consistent with comment 'Eloquent rejection before query'. Cash enrichment (ZReportCashEnrichmentService, not frozen) UPDATEs z_reports post-close — z_reports allows UPDATE so this is correct, but it means the signature must be re-stable across that path; verifySignature reads back the persisted aggregate columns + signature field and recomputes — re-stability holds only if cash enrichment does NOT alter signed columns. This is the boundary worth double-checking in DBA observation #DBA-OBS-2 below.

verified_invariants.name: audit_logs UPDATE/DELETE rejected at DB level on MySQL + SQLite
verified_invariants.evidence: Migration 2026_04_22_000002 lines 96-136 — installImmutabilityTriggers() creates audit_logs_no_update + audit_logs_no_delete on both drivers. Test coverage flagged via 'POS-9.4.3' tag (per migration docstring).

verified_invariants.name: z_reports DELETE rejected at DB level on MySQL/MariaDB
verified_invariants.evidence: Migration 2026_05_09_160000 lines 50-58 — z_reports_no_delete trigger via SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'. UPDATE intentionally allowed for state machine, documented in migration docstring lines 18-22.

verified_invariants.name: Composite UNIQUE(branch_id, fiscal_sequence_no) prevents gaps from concurrent inserts
verified_invariants.evidence: Migration 2026_04_22_000001 lines 36-44 — orders_branch_fiscal_seq_unique. Combined with FiscalSequenceService transactional SELECT MAX + 1 under lockForUpdate, the DB rejects any race that bypasses the cache lock.

verified_invariants.name: UNIQUE(branch_id, prev_hash) blocks chain forks at DB layer
verified_invariants.evidence: Migration 2026_04_22_100000 lines 33-39 — audit_logs_branch_prev_unique. AuditLogService::performInsert (line 187) retries once on QueryException with code 23000/23505 — defense-in-depth when Redis is down.

verified_invariants.name: Cash + order_payments FK switched cascade → restrict
verified_invariants.evidence: Migration 2026_05_10_010000 lines 73-95 — cash_movements + order_payments FKs recreated with restrictOnDelete. Parent DELETE now fails fast at FK layer (cleaner than orphan rows). Plus BEFORE DELETE triggers on 3 child tables (lines 107-141).

verified_invariants.name: Production rollback of audit_logs is blocked at migration level
verified_invariants.evidence: Migration 2026_04_22_000002 lines 70-76 — down() throws RuntimeException when APP_ENV=production. NF525 6-year retention enforced at the migration layer.

verified_invariants.name: Column types support exact reproducibility
verified_invariants.evidence: audit_logs.prev_hash/current_hash CHAR(64) — exact sha256 hex length. z_reports total_* DECIMAL(15,2) — deterministic rounding (no float drift). audit_logs.payload JSON — canonical encoding via canonicalise() in AuditLogService.

verified_invariants.name: First row prev_hash NULL is safe under UNIQUE
verified_invariants.evidence: Migration 2026_04_22_100000 docstring lines 22-25 — MySQL + SQLite >=3.9 treat each NULL as distinct, so first row per branch is safe.

structural_observations.label: TRUNCATE bypass is documented but not mitigated at migration level
structural_observations.evidence: audit_logs migration line 96-136 (no mention) — partially. z_reports migration lines 30-34 explicit. P0-FIX-4 migration lines 48-50 explicit. CLAUDE.md §8 mentions 'TRUNCATE bypass mitigated via GRANT level (deploy doc)'. Verify deploy doc actually contains the runbook (docs/FISCAL_SECRETS.md or docs/DEPLOY.md not in scope of this read-only audit).

structural_observations.label: z_reports UPDATE is allowed → cash enrichment must not touch signed columns
structural_observations.evidence: Migration 2026_05_09_160000 lines 18-22 — UPDATE intentionally allowed because of open→closed→archived state machine + ZReportCashEnrichmentService post-close enrichment. The signed aggregate columns (total_ttc, total_ht, total_tva, total_by_method, total_by_tax_rate, order_count, cancel_count, refund_count, sequence_no, closed_at) are the inputs to computeSignature. Cash enrichment must NOT touch these. Recommendation: add a CHECK constraint or column-level trigger that rejects UPDATE on signed columns after status=CLOSED.

structural_observations.label: audit_logs has NO unique constraint on current_hash (just prev_hash)
structural_observations.evidence: Migration 2026_04_22_100000 only creates UNIQUE(branch_id, prev_hash). Two consecutive rows in different branches could theoretically share current_hash if their canonical payloads + secrets collide — astronomically unlikely (sha256 + per-branch secret) but worth noting. NOT a bug — current_hash uniqueness is implied by sha256 + branch-scoped secret. No change recommended.

structural_observations.label: composition_snapshot has no DB-level immutability guard
structural_observations.evidence: Migration 2026_04_22_000020 only adds the column as JSON nullable. The application layer treats it as 'immutable post-payment' (see comments in OrderItem.php + ItemWizardStepVersion.php) but there is no DB trigger preventing UPDATE on a non-null composition_snapshot. A bug in OrderService that overwrites composition_snapshot on a paid order would silently corrupt the fiscal receipt. Worth considering a BEFORE UPDATE trigger that rejects changes when payment_status=PAID.

structural_observations.label: fiscal_alloc_error_at column supports the retry cron
structural_observations.evidence: Migration 2026_05_09_200000 adds nullable timestamp. RetryFiscalAllocCommand (everyMinute, Kernel.php:143) flips/retries based on this column. Schema is correctly minimal — no FK overhead. Index not present — could be added if the retry query becomes slow at scale (currently sparse predicate, fine for V1).

structural_recommendations_v1_1.label: Add composition_snapshot UPDATE rejection trigger on PAID rows
structural_recommendations_v1_1.rationale: composition_snapshot is the NF525 per-line receipt SSOT, but currently only the application layer enforces immutability. A bug in OrderService or a direct DB write could corrupt it without any database guard. Adding a BEFORE UPDATE trigger on order_items that rejects changes to composition_snapshot when the parent order has payment_status=PAID would close the only DB-layer gap in fiscal evidence.
structural_recommendations_v1_1.frozen_impact: New migration, no frozen file touched.

structural_recommendations_v1_1.label: Lock signed aggregate columns on closed Z reports
structural_recommendations_v1_1.rationale: z_reports UPDATE is allowed to support cash enrichment + archived_at update, but cash enrichment must never touch the signed columns. Add a BEFORE UPDATE trigger that rejects UPDATE on (total_ttc, total_ht, total_tva, total_by_method, total_by_tax_rate, order_count, cancel_count, refund_count, sequence_no, closed_at, signature, prev_hash) when status=CLOSED — only status (→ ARCHIVED) and archived_at + cash enrichment columns may change.
structural_recommendations_v1_1.frozen_impact: New migration, no frozen file touched. Cash enrichment service code needs to be reviewed for any accidental update of signed columns.

structural_recommendations_v1_1.label: Document the actual prod DB GRANT runbook for TRUNCATE mitigation
structural_recommendations_v1_1.rationale: Three migrations reference 'deploy doc' but the deploy doc is not in scope here. If TRUNCATE is not actually revoked on the production DB user, the trigger story is incomplete and a sysadmin could wipe the fiscal trail in one statement (NF525 prison risk). VERIFY: docs/DEPLOY.md or docs/FISCAL_SECRETS.md contains an explicit REVOKE DROP, TRUNCATE ON audit_logs/z_reports FROM 'foodking'@'%' runbook AND the DBA user role used by migrations is separated from the app runtime user.

structural_recommendations_v1_1.label: Consider per-row HMAC on z_reports archived columns
structural_recommendations_v1_1.rationale: Cash enrichment writes columns AFTER signature is computed. While the signed columns are protected (DBA-REC-V11-2), the cash columns themselves are not signed. A tamper of cash_in/cash_out/etc. would not break the chain. Adding a second HMAC over (signature || cash_columns) signed at archive time would close this. Probably overkill for V1.
structural_recommendations_v1_1.frozen_impact: would touch ZReportService — frozen, requires LOCK doc.

specialist_verdict: GREEN — DB layer is correctly hardened. Two P1 V1.1 backlog items (composition_snapshot UPDATE trigger + z_reports signed-column lock trigger) are defense-in-depth, not active vulnerabilities. One P2 to verify the deploy-doc GRANT mitigation exists.
